 Jim Duggan Recalls Andre The Giant Making Him Bleed With Just His Thumb 
 Jim Duggan looks back on an instance where Andre The Giant made him bleed by using just his thumb during a match together.
 Corey Brennan November 18, 2026, 12:37 pm 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Bluesky 
 Jim Duggan looks back on an instance where Andre The Giant made him bleed by using just his thumb during a match together.
 Duggan throughout his career was no stranger to being a babyface who worked from under several giants over the years, including the likes of The Big Show, Yokozuna and Andre The Giant.
 While speaking to Sporf in a new interview, Jim Duggan recalled a moment where Andre The Giant would cause him to bleed by hitting him in the face with his thumb.
 “If there was a giant in our business, Yokozuna, Umaga, The Big Show, Andre the Giant, it was ‘Duggan, get your 2×4’; I had to wrestle every giant there was. I ran down; I had my chin on Andre’s belly, I’m looking up at him like, ‘I’m not afraid of you’. He went to grab me, and his thumb hit my lip, and my lip fell down, and blood came pouring down my chest. It actually worked out great, everyone was like, ‘Where did the blood come from’? He beat me up with his thumb. WWF went off the air with me standing over Andre the Giant, covered in blood.” 
 Elsewhere in another recent interview, Duggan spoke about Bryan Danielson. You can read more about that here.
